title: Connect an NMEA 2000 network
summary: Your NMEA 2000 instruments in Signal K, and Signal K data on the NMEA 2000 bus.
description: Both do NMEA 2000 alongside their main job: the 8-relay board switches its relays from the bus, and the P4 cockpit is a Signal K to NMEA 2000 gateway. A small node that does only NMEA 2000 is planned.
